messages:
Alex R: Quick sync — scheduling a launch checkpoint for release v3.4. Cut window proposal: Wed Apr 28 16:00 UTC. Can people confirm availability and who can own canary/rollback?
Jamie L: 16:00 UTC works for infra. I can own canary.
Sunil P: I have an all-hands 16:15-17:00 UTC. Prefer 17:00 but can do 16:00 if we keep it tight.
Maria G: 16:00 is fine from PM side. QA needs ~60m lead to run full smoke after canary.
Priya S: QA can run smoke at ~16:05, need feature flags toggled by 15:50. I can own smoke run.
Alex R: Two quick asks: 1) fill attendance below, 2) vote on agenda block length. Poll link: https://poll.internal/release-334 (placeholder)
Jamie L: Poll filled. infra + oncall will be present. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: heads-up — automated canary job `job-334-canary` will run when a canary owner posts `/deploy canary` in this thread.
QA-Bot: QA checklist reminder — please attach artifacts to #artifacts-channel. Quick template: ```- smoke: pass/fail
- perf: baseline vs current
- logs: attach link```
Alex R: Draft agenda (30m total): ```- Rollcall (5m)
- Canary run + smoke verification (15m)
- Rollout decision and rollout plan (5m)
- Post-rollout verifications + next steps (5m)```
Sunil P: Add rollback plan + capacity cut owner (5m). Who can cut capacity if needed?
Maria G: +1 include rollback step and checklist for feature-flagging.
Alex R: Good call — updated agenda to include rollback owner.
Alex R: Current attendance list: Alex R, Jamie L (infra), Priya S (QA), Maria G (PM), Sunil P (platform tentative), OpsLead (ops) — OpsLead can you confirm?
OpsLead: I can make 16:00 UTC but not 17:00. I'll be on-call and can coordinate rollback/traffic shift.
Jamie L: I'll hand off oncall notes to OpsLead before the window.
Priya S: QA will block the rollout if smoke fails or we see perf regressions.
Alex R: Final ask — PM, SRE, Legal (if needed) confirm attendance by EOD. If no objections I'll lock the agenda and send calendar invites for 16:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
Jamie L: Pinged @LegalOps and @BillingPM to confirm.
Sunil P: If we need to shift to 17:00 I can adjust but prefer 16:00 given OpsLead availability.
Alex R: Locked to 16:00 UTC per OpsLead availability. Calendar invite + agenda + checklist going out in ~10m. Thanks all.
